beats.narration: With kratom, could how often you take it matter more than how much?
beats.visualPurpose: Open on the surprising comparison rather than a study title

beats.narration: A study of three hundred ninety five regular users found withdrawal symptoms were more closely linked to dosing frequency than dose amount.
beats.visualPurpose: Make the direction of association immediately clear without a causal claim
beats.visualAction: Animate two association columns with frequency highlighted; no invented effect-size graph

beats.narration: Kratom contains mitragynine. This research looked at people's kratom use, not purified mitragynine by itself.
beats.visualPurpose: Prevent interpreting product-level observations as isolated compound causality
beats.visualAction: Identify kratom leaf then a separately labeled compound icon
beats.factualAuthority: PMID 38788532 cohort and general botanical chemistry

beats.narration: The researchers surveyed U S adults in twenty twenty two. Almost all regularly used whole leaf products.

beats.visualPurpose: Make causal limitation large and unavoidable

beats.narration: The takeaway? How frequently someone uses a product deserves attention, not just the amount in one dose.
